candidate_window.selection: The incident UTC day used in the existing central_protocol_20261020.json; retain all other receipts separately, without classifying them as legitimate.
candidate_window.interpretation: Retrospective date-based candidate interval, not verified attack start/end or proof of compromise of every input address. Confirmation times are not broadcast times.

case_context_sources.role: Existing case/collector attribution; not an address-specific source or device label
Professor-supplied incident reporting; not a verified per-address list
Professor-supplied technical context; does not identify the device behind each source address

label_policy: Record observed input relationships only. Compromise, hardware control, entity identity and supervised labels stay unknown/null. No negative class is inferred from later receipts.
evaluation_policy: Dataset construction only; no fitting or train/test split. All records retain the single incident group. Define a new protocol before a predictive experiment.
publication_policy: Commit the protocol, aggregate summary, code and checks. Generate the exact address/outpoint registry locally from the already committed pinned history; do not publish a new bulk list of alleged victims.
